name: sw-update-toast
note: S-SW-UPDATE-CUE (UAT 2026-08-09, PR #328: the operator lost a THIRD review round to a stale cached build - 'I still see play buttons and squashed dwd' - after PR #306's two). sw.js skipWaiting+claims, so a new build takes control mid-session while the rendered page stays the old artifact. The fix: a persistent tap-to-reload toast on controllerchange WHEN a controller already existed (a real update); first-install control shows nothing (page and cache already match). Second goto = a controlled page (hadController true); a synthetic controllerchange then models the new build claiming. The toast never auto-hides and its tap reloads.

steps.label: arrange: this load is CONTROLLED by the worker (hadController true) and no update toast is up
act: a new build takes control mid-session (synthetic controllerchange on the same listener surface)
the cue PERSISTS (no auto-hide - the page stays stale until acted on) and repeats never stack
the tap RELOADED into a working app (toast gone, tabbar up)
